subject: Construction Manager Selection and Design Efficiencies
overview: The committee voted to enter negotiations with a construction management firm and approved a series of HVAC, solar, and space-efficiency recommendations to reduce the overall project scope. These decisions brought the estimated total project cost down to approximately $699 million prior to the next design phase.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from September 22, 2026.

items.title: Contract Amendment for SMMA
items.summary: Approved a $6,600 contract amendment for a consultant to design a radon mitigation system for the new building.

items.title: Selection of Construction Manager at Risk
items.summary: Voted to enter contract negotiations with Suffolk, the top-ranked firm among four bidders, to serve as the construction manager for the duration of the project.

items.title: HVAC and Solar System Recommendations
items.summary: Approved an air-to-water heat pump system and a net-zero solar plan using a Power Purchase Agreement for roof and parking canopies, avoiding the higher costs and legal complications of geothermal wells.

items.title: Kids Corner Program Review
items.summary: Approved a 350-square-foot increase for the municipal daycare program to accommodate six classrooms spanning infants through pre-kindergarten.

items.title: Medford Family Network (MFN) Review
items.summary: Approved a program configuration for the family support hub resulting in a 500-square-foot reduction through office consolidation.

items.title: Central Office and Welcome Center Reviews
items.summary: Approved administrative suite changes and maintained adjacencies for the registration hub, resulting in a net increase of 335 square feet to include district storage.

items.title: Chapter 74 CTE and Teen Health Center Reviews
items.summary: Approved space efficiencies for vocational programs and the health center, resulting in a combined net reduction of approximately 1,160 square feet.

items.title: High School Administration Review
items.summary: Approved a net reduction of 603 square feet by consolidating reception areas and reducing the size of the School Resource Officer and campus monitor offices.

items.title: Site and Parking Alternates
items.summary: Voted to eliminate all options for building athletic fields over parking structures to prioritize solar canopy installation and reduce structural costs.

items.title: Untabling Space Sufficiency Proposals
items.summary: Approved a motion to reduce a support classroom by 50 square feet while leaving all other previously tabled efficiency proposals off the current project scope.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Residents expressed a range of views on the project's nearly $700 million price tag, with some praising the recent $150 million in total reductions and others questioning the long-term tax impact.
